purpose: Determine whether official announcement text can be reconstructed with defensible point-in-time timestamps before any model training
scope: Metadata and document-identity audit only; no market prices, returns, labels, model fitting, portfolio replay or broker access
fixed_checks: Bind source announcement timestamp, official announcement id, security code, title and PDF path
Detect duplicate, corrected, supplemented, cancelled and withdrawn announcement relationships without using future text as prior text
Measure year/category/security coverage and missing-document rates before selecting any training sample
Keep retrieval time distinct from historical publication time and never claim historical first-seen evidence from a 2026 download
Reject documents whose identity, timestamp or revision lineage cannot be verified
acceptance: All audit rules and thresholds are frozen before reading aggregate coverage results
The frozen source row count and SHA256 match the V1 receipt
All 12 fixed pilot documents reproduce official ids, symbols, titles, publication dates and PDF identities with zero mismatch
Conflicting duplicate announcement ids and invalid required fields equal zero
Every 2015-2025 year/category cell has at least one record; counts are reported but are not tuned into a model gate
No event text is joined to a date earlier than its source publication timestamp
Every correction, supplement, cancellation or withdrawal has explicit source lineage or remains quarantined
Historical first-seen proof must predate or equal the proposed effective date; a 2026 retrieval never satisfies this gate
